does: Sets the result line of the roll screen once a dialogue roll resolves: success or failure, of a skill (id below 0x12) or of an ability, from the roll's eoc::active_roll::ModifiersComponent and state.

evidence.says: reads eoc::active_roll::ModifiersComponent of the roll entity, the success flag at +0x4C of the view model and the skill/ability id at +0xD12, then calls one of GetSuccessSkillCheckString, GetFailedSkillCheckString, GetSuccessAbilityCheckString, GetFailedAbilityCheckString
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a dialogue was on (segments 5, 16, 31, 32), 5 times from 1 place, the per-frame active-roll update at +0x1549B20

questions.ask: A dialogue check, passed and failed, of a skill and of an ability, with the roll screen's result line read after the call would show the four texts.
